sentences.en: Objective:To determine the incidence of refracture after callus distraction and explore the risk factors associated with refracture so as to find out the preventive measures.
sentences.vi: Mục tiêu: Xác định tỷ lệ mắc tật khúc xạ sau phân tâm mô sẹo và tìm hiểu các yếu tố nguy cơ liên quan đến khúc xạ để từ đó tìm ra các biện pháp phòng ngừa.

sentences.en: Methods 13 cases of refracture of the bone after operation were followed up and analyzed.

sentences.en: The mean incidence of refracture was 15.9%, and in hip fracture group, it was 21.21%, the highest among all groups. BMD decreased in each refracture group.
